notes: Take attendance on your phone: one tap per student cycles present, absent and late, and Everyone is here takes the rest.
After class, a lesson on your phone has Got to slide n of N and a note. It lands on the lesson in your Planner.
Lessons with lots of pictures now reach your phone too. The pictures load the first time you open the lesson while online.
When a lesson focus session ends, the Planner asks Is this lesson ready? The editor has a Ready button too. After three ready lessons you see about how long a lesson takes you.
Today's Focus card and Plan lessons show next week's lessons planned as dots. In a free period with nothing to mark, the Focus card suggests the next lesson to plan.
